name: Be thui
summary: The 18 May 2020 page names bê thui as a Da Nang dish for a longer stay and does not describe it. The 16 Apr 2024 page describes bê thui Cầu Mống: young beef roasted over charcoal, sliced thin, and says the real plate is in Điện Bàn.
origin: Named in Da Nang on the 2020 page. The described plate, bê thui Cầu Mống, is Điện Bàn on the 2024 page.
taste: The 16 Apr 2024 page calls the Điện Bàn beef slightly sweet, chewy, and nutty, with a bowl of nước mắm cái.
howToEat: For the Cầu Mống plate, the 16 Apr 2024 page says to eat the thin slices with bean sprouts, green banana, sour star fruit, and herbs, rolled in a thin crisp rice cracker.
The dip it names is nước mắm cái made from anchovy, with garlic, chili, ground ginger, roasted sesame, and lime.
The 18 May 2020 page does not say that this is the bowl, and it does not name a Da Nang door. Check on arrival if you are not riding to Điện Bàn.
where: The 16 Apr 2024 page says the real bê thui Cầu Mống is in Điện Bàn. It does not print a street number. The 18 May 2020 page names bê thui in Da Nang and does not name a door.
seoTitle: Be thui — Da Nang names it, Dien Ban describes it
seoDescription: Da Nang’s 2020 page names bê thui and does not describe it. The 2024 page describes bê thui Cầu Mống and says the real plate is in Điện Bàn. Check on arrival.
